entries.title: Medical Officer
entries.organization: Khulna Medical College Hospital, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
bullets: Lead antimicrobial stewardship activities: audit-feedback mechanisms, empiric therapy alignment with national guidelines, and resistance surveillance integration.
Drive EMR transformation in orthopedic outpatient services: standardized templates, staff training, and improved data completeness (from 85% to 97%).

Directed the hospital's infection prevention and control (IPC) rollout, aligning clinicians, nurses, and support staff to standardize protocols across high-volume wards, and launched a color-coded waste-management program.
Provide clinical care for 50+ patients daily in an over-capacity tertiary care setting.

entries.title: Resident Medical Officer / Medical Officer, Disease Control
entries.organization: Terokhada Upazila Health Complex, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
bullets: Led public health activities and community outreach to boost awareness and service uptake.
Coordinated with public health officers, epidemiologists, health educators, and local government to deliver quarantine, isolation, and treatment for 2,000+ COVID-19 patients.
Led contact tracing operations with 150+ healthcare workers and 50 volunteers, from case investigation to follow-up.
Served as local administrator for the Government's vaccination platform (Surokkha), resolving registration and scheduling issues.
Directed the COVID-19 vaccination campaign for 150,000+ people, achieving 99.7% of the target coverage.

entries.title: Medical Officer (Maternal, Child Health and Family Planning)
entries.organization: Morrelganj Family Planning Office, Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh
bullets: Provided family planning services, delivering counseling, ensuring contraceptive availability, and promoting gender-equitable decision-making.
Delivered comprehensive maternal and child health care, including antenatal care, safe delivery, postnatal follow-up, and newborn care with nutrition, vaccination, and breastfeeding support.
Served as Drawing and Disbursing Officer: managed treasury drawdowns and disbursed funds to authorized recipients, maintaining complete, audit-ready records.
Managed data collection from 200+ field staff, analyzed weekly datasets, and ensured timely DHIS2 uploads.

entries.title: From Register to Electronic Medical Records: A Data-Quality Audit in a Bangladeshi Orthopaedic Outpatient Department
bullets: Retrospective audit of 4,085 orthopedic outpatient records assessing completeness, validity, and internal consistency.
Provided evidence for EMR implementation in a resource-limited setting.
Preprint posted; manuscript under review at BMC Health Services Research.

entries.title: Hidden Co-resistance Modules in Wound Enterobacterales: Network-based Evidence from a Bangladeshi Tertiary Hospital (2018-2022)
bullets: Quantified third-generation cephalosporin resistance patterns.
Mapped co-resistance networks to identify carbapenem-sparing options.
Led study design, analysis, and manuscript preparation; manuscript under final co-author review.

entries.title: Co-resistance Network Identifies Antibiotic Hub Signals for Empiric Pseudomonas aeruginosa Wound Therapy
bullets: Analyzed resistance profiles using CLSI disk diffusion.
Built a co-resistance network using Spearman correlations and bootstrap validation.
Poster presented at the BSAC Winter Conference: Infection 2025, Birmingham, UK.
